enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Breathe deeply. Turn on back. Put arm under pillow. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket down. Breathe. Turn to right side.

Wake up. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply shampoo to hair. Rub hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out milk. Take out butter. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out plate. Take out pan. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil to pan. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Pour eggs into pan. Fry eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Put eggs on plate. Open bread bag. Take out two slices of bread. Put bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Wait for toast. Toast pops up. Take toast. Butter toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Eat toast. Drink milk. Stand up. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Pick up phone. Check phone. Pick up bag. Put phone in bag. Pick up keys. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver seat. Close car door. Buckle seatbelt. Insert key. Turn key. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Put car in gear. Release parking brake. Drive. Stop at red light. Wait. Drive. Stop at red light. Wait. Drive. Park car. Turn off engine. Unbuckle seatbelt. Open car door. Get out. Close car door. Lock car. Walk to workplace.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into workplace. Clock in. Put on scrubs. Put on gloves. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check patient's chart. Take patient's temperature. Take blood pressure. Take pulse. Administer medication. Talk with patient. Write notes. Walk to next patient. Repeat. Walk to break room. Get coffee. Return to desk. Answer phone. Write email. Walk to meeting. Sit in meeting. Discuss cases. Return to desk.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Get salad. Get sandwich. Get drink. Pay for food. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat salad. Eat sandwich. Drink. Talk with colleague. Clear tray. Throw away trash. Walk back to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Check vitals. Administer treatment. Consult with doctor. Update records. Walk to nurse station. Answer phone. Write notes. Walk to supply room. Get supplies. Return to patient room. Administer medication. Talk with patient. Walk to break room. Get water. Return to desk. Write report. Attend meeting. Discuss cases. Return to desk.
Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit. Close door. Buckle seatbelt. Start engine. Drive. Stop at traffic. Drive. Park. Turn off engine. Unbuckle. Get out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Take out pan. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Place cutting board on counter. Cut vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pot on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Turn off cooker. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Clear table.

Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates into dishwasher. Load utensils. Close dishwasher. Add detergent. Start dishwasher. Wipe counter with sponge. Wipe stove. Sweep floor. Take out trash. Replace trash bag. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV and using computer with fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on bed. Change channel. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Open browser. Browse internet. Watch TV. Change channel. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to bedroom. Sit on bed. Eat snack. Put snack wrapper on nightstand. Pick up remote. Change channel. Use computer. Check phone. Turn off TV. Close laptop. Turn off fan. Turn off light. Lie down.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face with soap. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Apply moisturizer. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bedroom. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Breathe. Turn on back. Put arm under pillow. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down. Breathe. Turn to right side.
